main_text.p: 36 Et Saaraim, & Adithaim, & Gederah,& Gederothaim: vrbes quatuordecim,& villæ earum.
41 Et Gederoth, Beth-dagon, & Naamah, & Makeda: vrbes sexdecim, & villæ earum.
44 Et Cheila, & Achzib, & Maresah: vrbes nouem & villæ earum.
46 Ab Ecron, & ad mare, omnes quæ sunt ad latus Asdod, & villæ earum.
47 Asdod, oppida eius, & villæ eius: Azza, oppida eius, & villæ eius

page.notes: The last line is cut off at the foot of this part. "Iocteel" is copied as printed; the final letters are uncertain. The line "Senā" carries a tilde over the a. The first line "Chithlis." is a running fragment; the catchword "vsque" is printed at the lower right. Some marginal-looking ink specks were ignored. Spelling "Maresah" and "Asna" as printed in the scan's text; the scan shows "Mare-|sah" hyphenated at the line end.
